question: Which of the following states witnessed the swearing-in of a newly elected government led by the NDA coalition in November 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The state of **Bihar** held its **Legislative Assembly elections** in late **2025**, resulting in the formation of a new government led by the **NDA (National Democratic Alliance)**.
 
• The **NDA coalition**, primarily comprising the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and the **Janata Dal (United) [JD(U)]** along with other regional partners, secured a majority in the **243-member** house.
 
• The swearing-in ceremony took place in **November 2025**, marking the commencement of a new term for the state executive in **Patna**.
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** conducted the polls in multiple phases across the state to ensure a smooth democratic process. ***Hence, the correct answer is Bihar.***
